title: The Slow Harbor
author: Zephyrine Lockridge
blurb: Hazel Iversen, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
